**Kenya: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 593,327 applications. The largest annual volume was 92,937 in 2023; 2025 recorded 32,718. Applications in 2025 were 154% higher than in 2019 (12,886). In 2025, 33,722 recorded decisions equated to 103 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 63% lower than in 2024 (88,027). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 4 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Somalia (17,634), Eritrea (4,084), Burundi (3,583).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 100%, across 15,622 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 54% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 0.0 percentage points higher than in 2024 (100%).
